p4.behavior: variables/read_only/provider_flags는 파일 미소비. following 변수는 test_cli_feed.py:143 인라인으로 variant/pagination_source만 고정; 페이지네이션 실측 미확정은 유지. replies-next-batch.expected.first=4는 관찰값(옛 queries.json=10), RECENT와 x-asbd-id 출처도 미확정; 플랫폼 실측값을 코드 기본값으로 덮지 않는다.

about: What a request carries (appendix A 22, 25, 33, and the planning session's observation of the app's own requests on 2026-10-16). variables: the variables a read sends for a surface, with the parts that are facts marked; headers: where each header's value comes from in the logged-in tab; read_only: which operation names may ever be sent; provider_flags: which relay provider variables are accepted from a module or a learned value. All values are synthetic.

variables.name: profile-threads-tab-first-10
variables.fact: The profile threads tab query refuses more than ten posts a page with an execution error that looks like a rotated id, so it is always sent with first 10.

variables.name: profile-other-tabs-first
variables.fact: The replies, reposts and media tabs take a larger page (25 was accepted).

variables.name: search-posts-default
variables.fact: Post search sends search_surface default and recent 0 for top results.

variables.name: search-posts-tag-recent
variables.fact: Tag search sends search_surface tags; recent 1 asks for newest first.

variables.name: feed-for-you-next-page
variables.fact: Observed in the app: the for-you feed's next page is BarcelonaFeedPaginationDirectQuery with these variables (plus relay providers); the first page's cursor is in the document's feedData.page_info.

variables.name: feed-following-variant
variables.fact: The following feed is the same query with variant following and pagination_source text_post_feed_following (the old reader's first-page variables; the pagination variables are to be confirmed in P2 R3).

variables.name: post-page-downward
variables.fact: Observed in the app: the post page asks BarcelonaPostPageDownwardQuery with {postID, sortOrder: TOP} and receives the first direct replies with a cursor.

variables.name: replies-next-batch
variables.fact: Observed in the app: the next reply batch is BarcelonaPostPageDirectRepliesRefetchQuery with {after, filterType: null, first: 4, postID, sortOrder: TOP}.
variables.verify: P2 R2: whether first may be larger, and the RECENT sort value

variables.name: following-next-page
variables.fact: Following's next page is the same tab query with {userID, first 20, after: <offset>}; observed 2026-10-17, its refetchable twin is not defined on the profile screen.

headers.fact: Observed in the logged-in tab (2026-10-16): the app's GraphQL POST carries X-CSRFToken = the csrftoken cookie, X-IG-App-ID = CurrentUserInitialData.APP_ID, X-FB-LSD = the form's lsd, X-FB-Friendly-Name = the operation name; the form is the page's own async params (fb_dtsg, lsd, jazoest, __user, ...) plus doc_id and variables. X-ASBD-ID is a fixed observed string whose module source was not found (P2 R1). The old reader hard-coded the app id; the tab's value is the source now.
headers.verify: P2 R1: endpoint per query (/api/graphql/ or /graphql/query), the remaining form fields the app sends, X-ASBD-ID source

read_only.fact: Only reads are ever sent: a name must end in Query and must not contain Mutation, and it must be on this reader's list of read queries.

cases.name: BarcelonaMutationProbeQuery
cases.why: names a mutation, even on the read list and ending in Query

provider_flags.fact: Relay provider variables learned from document preloader values are named __relay_internal__pv__<Name>relayprovider; only booleans, integers and upper-case constant strings are accepted there. Live module provider.get() values are read directly and are not subject to this document-learning filter.
